info.title: Digital Health REST API
info.description: National healthcare — hospitals, patients, appointments, encounters, prescriptions, lab, radiology, insurance and audit management API.

parameters.name: X-CSRF-TOKEN
parameters.description: Required. Value returned as 'csrfToken' from the final step of login (/auth/select-role or /auth/login when no facility/role selection is needed) or /auth/refresh. Must be re-sent on every state-changing request.
